overview_description.description:
Trendyol is a tech company that provides an e-commerce experience to its customers and vendors. It aims to serve customers to buy what they want, when they want with the best experience driven by technology. 

Founded in 2010, Trendyol is the largest internet employer in Turkey with a team of ca. 2000 people. In 2018, the company announced an investment and strategic partnership with Alibaba Group. Alibaba's investment into Trendyol is the largest internet sector investment in Turkey to date.
